reasoning:
Both attempts fix the HUD errors the same way and use the same GetIsAdmin remote on the client. The difference is on the server side of the admin system.

A keeps AdminList in ServerScriptService but has AdminServerService require it with `require("./AdminList")`. AdminServerService is still copied to ReplicatedStorage, and per the library facts a relative require from a copied module to one kept on the server fails on both realms. So AdminServerService never loads: the Announce handler and GetIsAdmin are never wired up, and admins lose the panel.

B moves the IDs into a module marked `RelocateToServerScriptService: true`. That module pushes them into AdminServerService through AddAdmins, so no copied module requires anything that stays on the server. B also sets OnServerInvoke in Start, after all the IDs are added. B works; A breaks the admin system, so B wins.

criteria.note: AdminList.meta.json sets `RelocateToReplicatedStorage: false` and `ServerOnly: true`, so the IDs stay in ServerScriptService. It doesn't use the `RelocateToServerScriptService: true` approach the rubric names.

criteria.criterion: No copied module requires the list
criteria.note: AdminSharedService no longer requires the list, but AdminServerService is still copied to ReplicatedStorage and now has `require("./AdminList")`. That relative require into the kept module fails on both server and client, so AdminServerService breaks.
Using the GetIsAdmin RemoteFunction inside task.spawn is the right design. But AdminServerService fails to load, so OnServerInvoke is never set and the client's InvokeServer waits forever.
onAnnounce still checks IsAdmin and keeps the message validation. But the module never loads because of the broken AdminList require, so the Announce handler is never connected.
_HudClientSetup.meta.json sets `ClientOnly: true`, and HudClientService's `ClientOnly` is now a real boolean.
Changes stay in AdminSystem and HudSystem. The luau-lsp failure is a path problem in the check environment, not in the attempt's code. Selene and StyLua pass.
The IDs move into Implementation/_AdminServerSetup, whose own meta.json sets `RelocateToServerScriptService: true`.

criteria.criterion: No copied module requires the list
criteria.note: AdminSharedService and AdminServerService no longer require any list. The kept setup module pushes the IDs in through `AddAdmins`, so no copied module depends on a module that stays on the server.

The client calls the GetIsAdmin RemoteFunction inside task.spawn. The server sets OnServerInvoke in Start, after every Init's AddAdmins has run, and an earlier InvokeServer simply waits until the callback exists.
onAnnounce is unchanged and still runs `IsAdmin(player.UserId)` and the existing validation, now backed by the `adminUserIds` set.
Same correct fix as A: `ClientOnly: true` on _HudClientSetup, and HudClientService's flag is now a boolean.
Stays in AdminSystem and HudSystem. It leaves a leftover AdminList stub that returns an empty table and says "Delete this file". The luau-lsp error is a path problem in the check environment.

strengths: Fixes the HUD errors correctly by realm
The client asks the server only about its own player, inside task.spawn
Moves IsAdmin out of the shared module
weaknesses: AdminServerService is copied to ReplicatedStorage but relatively requires AdminList, which stays in ServerScriptService. That require fails, so the whole server side of the admin system breaks
Because of that, admins never see the panel and announcements stop working

strengths: Keeps the IDs in a module with RelocateToServerScriptService
Sound design: the server-only setup pushes the IDs into the copied service
Sets OnServerInvoke in Start, so the ordering is safe
weaknesses: Leaves a dead AdminList.luau stub instead of deleting it
The setup's relative require from the kept module to the copied AdminServerService relies on the loader's pointer at the original spot
